provider: Purdue Geospatial Data Science Lab / Indiana 3DEP NDHM; source tile hosted in Indiana Geographic Information Office S3 elevation catalog
feature_id: Indiana DEM Tile Footprints OBJECTID 35355; corresponding NDHM tile in2018_29951880_12_ndhm.tif
source_crs: EPSG:2968 / NAD83(HARN), Indiana West, US survey feet (GeoTIFF keys)

vertical_units.basis: The Indiana 3DEP source LiDAR and DTM are documented in U.S. survey feet; NDHM is object height above ground derived from those elevations. The method/units reference is saved alongside this raster.

measurement_method: Convert official Purdue FID266 outline to the raster's EPSG:2968 coordinate grid. Read valid NDHM raster cells whose centers fall inside the footprint, classify north/main versus south-addition pixels using the 2023 orthophoto roof-zone boundary, and summarize each sample set by median and interquartile range. Reproducible code and output are `analyze_ndhm_roof_heights.py` and `ndhm_roof_height_statistics.json`.
uncertainty: NDHM is a 5-ft grid, not a surveyed eave point measurement; returns may include rooftop equipment and edge effects. The 2018 height surface and 2023 roof-tone zones are from different dates. Median planes approximate each zone; local roof pitch and facade details are not measured.
